context:
Goal: findings about how you work, written in other repos, all reach claude-settings and get fixed here.
Problem (goal): the gather plan reads only each child's outbox folder, but the Nov 10 sweep found 29 claude-settings findings in the children's debts, notes and todo files, none in an outbox folder.
Based on (read): triage filed those 29 from home, banchi, degen and q_max.
Based on (measured): a check on Nov 10 found the outbox folders of q_max, banchi, degen, home and mailaudit holding a README only (11:12 CST).
Departs from: main — adds a gather of child repos' claude-settings findings; this pick sets which files it reads.

lastAnswer.note: children need to and will learn to pur those gripes in their outbox

options.gain: Findings land where sessions actually wrote them, as on Nov 10.
options.how: The gather reads each child's outbox folder, debts, notes and todo files for items about claude-settings.
options.label: Every place a child keeps one (Recommended)
options.lose: Sorting which lines are about claude-settings is judgement; unclear ones come to you or a refuter.

options.how: The gather reads only each child's roadmap/outbox folder.
options.label: Only the outbox folder
options.lose: The places where the 29 Nov 10 findings sat are never read again.

ref: plan PR #2974 (gather other repos' outbox findings), refuter finding P1; your ask on item 493 a
reply: Closed 00:51 CST Nov 13 by triage: you picked b (only the outbox folder; children learn to put findings there). Sent to lane outbox-aggregate-plan.
title: Does "outbox" mean only the outbox folder, or every place a child repo keeps a claude-settings finding?
why: You asked for the gather on Nov 10; the plan cannot settle its scope without your word.
